We are a Chiropractic Care and Wellness Center located in Northbrook, IL, dedicated to helping you live a pain-free life without relying on drugs or surgery. Our clinic is home to three experienced corrective care specialists: Dr. Gregg Gerstin (23+ yrs experience), Dr. Luke, and Dr. Britney.

We help active adults, desk workers, athletes, and families across Chicago’s North Shore find lasting solutions.

🔍 Common Conditions We Treat:
Sciatica & Pinched Nerves
Lower Back Pain & Stiff Joints
Neck Pain & Tension Headaches
Herniated & Bulging Discs
Arthritis & Joint Pain
Forward Head Posture & "Tech Neck"
Scoliosis & Spinal Misalignments

Unlike typical chiropractors who focus on quick pop-and-crack fixes, we prioritize true structural correction. We target the root cause of your pain to promote natural healing and deliver long-term relief so you can stay active for life.
